names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 16 Φεβρουαρίου, «Άγιος Μακάριος Μητροπολίτης Μόσχας», with the rank word and the see left off. No Russian form is printed on the page, and none is invented here.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 16 февраля ст. ст., «Святитель Макарий (Невский, Парвицкий), митрополит Московский и Коломенский», with the rank word and the see left off. The calendar gives two surnames in the brackets and the day's own line gives none.

death.note: As printed by days.pravoslavie.ru: «Свт. Макария митр. Московского и Коломенского (1926).»

feast.note: He is also kept on the Julian 5 October with the synaxis of the hierarchs of Moscow, «(Моск. Свт.)», as the seventeenth and last of its seventeen names, read on 2026-10-04 from days.pravoslavie.ru's own page for that day. One row per church is the schema, so the synaxis is recorded here and he does not render on it. He is the second Macarius on the line; the ninth is the metropolitan who died in 1563, who has his own folder.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 16 февраля ст. ст. — «Свт. Макария митр. Московского и Коломенского (1926).»
